# Órarend — Jedlik timetable

> Unofficial timetable viewer for the Győri SZC Jedlik Ányos technical school
> (Győr, Hungary). Every timetable on this site comes live from the school's
> own Jedlikinfo system. This site does not create timetable data of its own. The JSON endpoints below
> relay Jedlikinfo through a plain GET request. You do not need any headers,
> a login or an API key.

Jedlikinfo's own API (`https://jedlikinfo.jedlik.eu/api/api`) answers the
timetable request (`POST timetable/cards`) with 403 unless the request carries
Jedlikinfo's own `Origin` and `Referer`. Do not call it directly. Use the
endpoints below instead: this server calls Jedlikinfo with the right headers
and returns JSON.

The timetable changes during the week. Fetch it again each time you answer
instead of reusing an earlier answer. Responses are cached for up to 5 minutes.

## Timetable API

- [Classes and teachers](https://jedlik.info/api/orarend): `GET /api/orarend`
  with no parameters. Returns `{ classes: [{ short, name, url }], teachers: [{ short, name, url }] }`.
  Each `url` is the ready-made link to that class's or teacher's week. If your
  fetch tool can only open links it has already seen, open this list first
  and follow the `url` you need instead of building the address yourself.
- [A class's week](https://jedlik.info/api/orarend?osztaly=13C): `GET /api/orarend?osztaly=<class>`.
  The class code is case- and punctuation-insensitive (`13C`, `13.c` and `13 C` all work).
- [A teacher's week](https://jedlik.info/api/orarend?tanar=AA): `GET /api/orarend?tanar=<teacher short code or name>`.
- Other weeks: add `&het=YYYY-MM-DD`, using any date in the week you want. The
  default is the current week. Example:
  `https://jedlik.info/api/orarend?osztaly=13C&het=2026-10-05`.
- [Free rooms right now](https://jedlik.info/api/termek): `GET /api/termek`,
  optionally `?nap=YYYY-MM-DD&ido=HH:MM` (Budapest time). Returns `free`,
  `busy` and `unknown` rooms. Only works from one week back to three weeks ahead.
- [Who teaches which subject](https://jedlik.info/api/tantargyak): `GET /api/tantargyak`,
  optionally `?kereses=<text>` (subjects whose name or short code contains the
  text) or `?tantargy=<exact subject name>` (one subject). Accents and case do
  not matter. Returns `subjects: [{ name, short, teachers: [{ short, name, classes }],
  classes: [{ short, teachers }] }]`, built from this week and next week, so
  both A and B weeks are included. Clubs (szakkör) have teachers but no class.

Pass exactly one of `osztaly` or `tanar`, not both.

### Week response

```
{
  kind: "class" | "teacher",
  subject: { short, name },
  weekStart: "YYYY-MM-DD",            // Monday
  days: [{ name, dateKey, week, dayOfWeek, teaching, notes, bells }],
  periods: [{ number, start: "HH:MM", end: "HH:MM" }],
  lessons: [{
    dateKey, dayOfWeek, start: "HH:MM", end: "HH:MM",
    subject, subjectShort,
    teacher, teacherShort,           // on a class's timetable
    classShort, className,           // on a teacher's timetable
    room, group, groupColumn, groupCount, wholeClass,
    week,                            // "A" / "B" week letter
    moved,                           // true = Jedlikinfo marks the lesson as moved
    kind
  }]
}
```

- Every time is Budapest local time. `startMin` and `endMin` are the same times
  in minutes after midnight.
- `days[].teaching` is `false` on a day without teaching (holiday, school
  event), `true` on a teaching day and `null` if unknown. `days[].notes` lists
  school events for that day. When `days[].bells` is not `null`, that day
  runs on a different bell schedule (e.g. shortened lessons).
- Group splits: a class can have several lessons at the same time, one per
  group (`groupCount` > 1, `group` names the group). Only the student's own
  group attends. If you don't know which group they are in, list all of them.
  `wholeClass: true` means the whole class attends.
- Periods run from 0 to 9, from about 07:10 to 15:55.

### Errors

Errors return `{ error: { kind, title, message, hint?, retryable } }`, with the
text in Hungarian:
`400` bad parameters, `404` unknown class or teacher (fetch the list first),
`502` or `504` Jedlikinfo is unavailable or had no data for that week (e.g. a
holiday). This site did not cause these; retry later if `retryable` is true.

## Pages for humans

- [Weekly timetable](https://jedlik.info/orarend): the week grid (`?class=13C`)
- [Today](https://jedlik.info/ma): today's lessons and what is on now
- [Teachers' timetable](https://jedlik.info/tanari) (`?teacher=AA`)
- [Free rooms](https://jedlik.info/teremkereso)
- [Subjects](https://jedlik.info/tantargyak): who teaches a subject, and to which classes (`?tantargy=Fizika`)
- [Hall duty](https://jedlik.info/ugyelet)
